title: The invalid-list path does not say to hold `sweep-did-not-run` until the review request is issued, unlike the
text: The invalid-list path does not say to hold `sweep-did-not-run` until the review request is issued, unlike the unrecognized-value path. A failure after list loading but before the request could emit forbidden sweep metadata, contrary to AC1/AC19. Specify the pending record and its exact logging behavior for pre-request and post-request failures, and test both.
